categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Sinexcel Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: industrial supporting power supplies and power quality products, new energy vehicle charging and swapping equipment, new energy power conversion equipment including energy storage and microgrid systems, and battery formation and testing equipment. These segments serve high-end manufacturing, data centers, energy, rail transit, and new energy industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced power electronics technology focusing on power conversion and control. Key technologies include three-level modular power modules, silicon carbide (SiC) devices for enhanced voltage and temperature tolerance, modular design with hot-swappable features, and cloud-based remote monitoring platforms. It also develops high-power charging modules, energy storage converters, and battery testing systems using high-frequency, modular, and digital control technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include high-end manufacturing enterprises, data centers, semiconductor manufacturers, automotive manufacturers, energy companies, public infrastructure, and battery producers. The company serves markets such as AI and computing centers, new energy vehicles, renewable energy power stations, industrial parks, and laboratories for battery research and production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in North, East, South, Central, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest China regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries and sales in the United States, Europe (Germany), Singapore, Australia, South Korea, and Hong Kong, targeting global markets including Europe and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Sinexcel Electric Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of power electronic equipment and systems. It provides core components and integrated solutions to end-users and system integrators in energy, automotive charging infrastructure, and battery manufacturing sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment (~8-9% of revenue) to maintain technological leadership, focusing on power electronics innovation, high-efficiency charging modules, energy storage solutions, and battery testing technologies. It aims to expand product lines, enhance product performance and reliability, develop new energy vehicle charging technologies including V2G, and strengthen overseas market penetration. Digitalization, modularization, and integration of energy systems are key R&D themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of industrial power supplies, energy storage converters, electric vehicle charging and swapping equipment, and battery formation and testing devices. The company also provides integrated solutions and after-sales services, with some income from government subsidies and financial asset investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in low-voltage power quality products and new energy vehicle charging equipment, recognized as a top-tier brand in data center power quality solutions and a global top ten supplier of energy storage inverters. It competes with both domestic and international firms in power electronics and charging infrastructure, leveraging advanced technology and certifications to differentiate.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.04 billion, a 14.53% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 429 million, up 6.49%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.67 billion, growing 9.65% from the previous year. It maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding sales in industrial power supplies and electric vehicle charging equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, advanced modular design, and rapid maintenance capabilities in its products, such as hot-swappable modules and cloud-based remote monitoring. It leads in integrating silicon carbide technology for enhanced performance and safety features in charging systems. Its comprehensive solutions cover diverse applications from AI data centers to renewable energy and new energy vehicles, offering high efficiency, safety, and user-friendly operation to meet evolving customer demands.
